name: TYPE://SOUL
desc:
Controls:
Left Alt - Shift-lock
Ctrl + K - Monster transformations/Mask rip
J - Reaper weapon
Ctrl + J - Reaper transformation/Monster transformation
Q - Dash
Z X C - Element / Vollstandig Moveset
T G - Schrift / Element Release Moveset
R - Critical
N - Inventory/Skill tree
M - Meditate
P - Emote
B - Grip/Eat if Monster
V - Carry
L - Portals
Comma - Toggle map markers
M2 + M1 - Purify

This game contains jumpscares and flashing lights

Console Controls can be found in the Tutorial In-game
